sentences.text: Today we will talk about Slovenia.
Slovenia is a small, green and beautiful country in Europe.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Slovenia?
Slovenia is in Central Europe.
It is next to Italy, Austria, Hungary and Croatia.
It also has a small coast on the Adriatic Sea.
Slovenia has mountains, forests, rivers and caves.
What is the capital city of Slovenia?
The capital city is Ljubljana.
Ljubljana is small, clean and green.
It has a castle, a river and many bridges.
There are many cafes, bikes and parks.
Other cities include Maribor, in the east known for wine.
Bled, famous for a beautiful lake and island.
Kopar, a port on the Adriatic Sea.
How many people live in Slovenia?
About 2 million people live in Slovenia.
It is one of the smallest countries in Europe by population.
Most people live in towns and small cities.
What language do people speak in Slovenia?
People speak Slovenian or Slovenian.
It is the official language.
Many people also speak English, German or Italian, especially in tourist areas.
What is the weather like in Slovenia?
Slovenia has four seasons.
Spring, warm and full of flowers.
Summer, hot and sunny, good for swimming and hiking.
Autumn, cool with colorful trees.
Winter, cold with snow in the mountains.
It is a great country for skiing, cycling and nature trips.
What does Slovenia look like?
Slovenia has the Alps, tall, snowy mountains.
Forests covering more than half the country.
Rivers and lakes like Lake Bled and Lake Bohin Caves, such as the famous Pustoina Cave.
It is one of the greenest countries in the world.
What animals live in Slovenia?
In Slovenia you can see bears, foxes and deer in the forests.
Wolves and lynx in the mountains.
Eagles, owls and woodpeckers in the trees.
Fish, frogs and otters in the rivers.
Slovenia works hard to protect nature and wildlife.
What do people eat in Slovenia?
Slovenian food is fresh, simple and home cooked.
People eat bread, cheese and meat, potatoes, beans and cabbage, soups, stews and sausages, cakes, pastries and honey.
Popular dishes.
Yoda, bean and sauerkraut stew.
Kranjska klobasa, carniolan sausage.
Potacea, a rolled cake with nuts, honey or poppy seeds.
Strictly, dough rolls with different fillings.
What do people drink in Slovenia?
People drink water, tap water is very clean, herbal tea and coffee, fruit juice.
Adults may drink wine, beer or schnapps.
Slovenia is famous for its local wines and natural drinks.
What is life like in Slovenia?
Life in Slovenia is peaceful, safe and close to nature.
People enjoy, spending time outdoors, walking in the forest or mountains, cycling and skiing, cooking and eating with family, relaxing in cafes and reading books.
Slovenians like a clean and quiet way of life.
What are some holidays and traditions?
Independence Day, June 25th, Prezoran Day, February 8th, a cultural holiday Easter with eggs and potika, Christmas with lights and gifts, Carnival poost with masks and costumes.
In the town of two, people wear fur costumes and bells to scare away winter.
Some fun facts about Slovenia.
Slovenia is the only country with love in its name.
Over 60 % of the land is covered by forest.
The Lipizan or horse comes from Slovenia.
It has more than 10,000 caves.
The flag is white, blue and red with a mountain and stars.
Now you know many things about Slovenia.
You know where it is, what people eat and how they live.
You learned about the forests, traditions and beautiful lakes.
Well done!
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
